Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: Civil Registry Code dates from 1967 and has not been modernized. No digital CRVS system documented. World Bank diagnostic notes outdated legal framework with updates pending since 2006. The ENTD.GW strategy plans to address this as part of digital public services pillar but no operational system.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: No digital ID scheme exists. The Civil Registry Code dates from 1967 (pre-independence), with updates pending since 2006. World Bank Digital Economy Diagnostic 2022 states 'Absence of a structured foundational identity system prevents digital ID development.' No integration possible without foundational system.

Comments: No operational digital health platform documented. World Bank diagnostic found low digital competency in public sector generally. Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: Mobile money usage increased 77% in 2020 but no national digital financial services priority exists. Kontaktu (tax filing/payment system) is operational (homegrown). SIGFIP financial management partially adopted. No e-payments or e-transactions law. No interoperability with regional payment systems. The World Bank WARDIP project and ENTD.GW plan to address digital payments as a priority.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Digital services are extremely limited. Internet penetration 32.5% (2023). Most services are manual/offline. Universal Service Fund (USF) exists but is underutilized, lacking transparency and targeting. No digital ID, no e-services accessible to most citizens. Digital literacy is very low.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Draft laws for data privacy and cybercrime exist but not promulgated as of World Bank diagnostic 2022. No government data center or disaster recovery center exists; data stored on individual ministry servers without shared infrastructure. ENTD.GW plans data centers and e-gov by 2030. No enforced data sovereignty provisions in place.
